308: int vs_network_request_mode(struct vs_network_s *network,

310: {
311:   int ret;
312: 
313:   if (network == NULL)
314:     return -EINVAL;
315: 
316:   network->status.state = VS_NET_SWITCHING;
317: 
318:   if (network->mode == VS_NET_AP && mode == VS_NET_STA)
319:     {
320:       ret = vs_network_stop_provisioning(network);
321:       if (ret < 0)
322:         {
323:           network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
324:           network->status.error = ret;
325:           return ret;
326:         }
327: 
328:       /* stop() joins the listener, so no callback can race with this consume.
329:        * Apply a completed save even when manual exit won the UI race; discard
330:        * a failed save because the user explicitly chose to leave AP.
331:        */
332:       ret = vs_network_consume_saved(network, true);
333:       if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENOENT)
334:         {
335:           network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
336:           network->status.error = ret;
337:           return ret;
338:         }
339:     }
340: 
341:   ret = vs_network_stop_dhcp(network);
342:   if (ret < 0)
343:     {
344:       network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
345:       network->status.error = ret;
346:       return ret;
347:     }
348: 
349:   /* AP resources are gone before STA association begins.  If association or
350:    * DHCP then fails, the next network toggle must be able to enter AP again.
351:    */
352:   if (mode == VS_NET_STA)
353:     {
354:       network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
355:       network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
356:     }
357: 
358:   ret = mode == VS_NET_AP ? vs_network_apply_ap(network) :
359:                              vs_network_apply_sta(network);
360:   if (ret < 0)
361:     {
362:       network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
363:       network->status.error = ret;
364:     }
365: 
366:   return ret;

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c
3:  *
4:  * The socket half of the provisioning entry.  Deliberately POSIX-only so the
5:  * accept loop, the ordering guarantee and one-shot mode can be exercised over
6:  * loopback on the host; the only thing left for the board is whether the
7:  * SoftAP and SD-NAND are actually there.
8:  *
9:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
10:  ****************************************************************************/
11: 
12: #include <arpa/inet.h>
13: #include <errno.h>
14: #include <netinet/in.h>
15: #include <poll.h>
16: #include <pthread.h>
17: #include <stdbool.h>
18: #include <stdio.h>
19: #include <string.h>
20: #include <sys/socket.h>
21: #include <unistd.h>
22: 
23: #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
24: #include "vp_form.h"
25: #include "vp_http.h"
26: #include "vp_store.h"
27: 
28: #define VP_STATE_IDLE     0
29: #define VP_STATE_RUNNING  1
30: #define VP_STATE_FINISHED 2  /* the thread returned, still needs a join */
31: 
32: #define VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS  200
33: #define VP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS 5000
34: #define VP_STORE_PATH_MAX  192
35: #define VP_THREAD_STACK    8192
36: 
37: struct vp_server_s
38: {
39:   int       listenfd;
40:   pthread_t thread;
41:   int       state;
42:   bool      stopping;
43:   bool      one_shot;
44:   char      store_path[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX];
45:   uint32_t  generation;
46:   velasight_prov_saved_cb_t on_saved;
47:   void     *cb_arg;
48: };
49: 
50: static struct vp_server_s g_server =
51: {
52:   .listenfd = -1,
53:   .state    = VP_STATE_IDLE,
54: };
55: 
56: static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
57: 
58: /* Request and response buffers are static because only one connection is
59:  * served at a time and 6KB of thread stack on this part is not free.
60:  */
61: 
62: static char g_request[VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS + VP_HTTP_MAX_BODY + 1];
63: static char g_response[VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX];
64: 
65: static int vp_write_all(int fd, const char *data, size_t len)
66: {
67:   size_t sent = 0;
68: 
69:   while (sent < len)
70:     {
71:       ssize_t n = write(fd, data + sent, len - sent);
72: 
73:       if (n < 0)
74:         {
75:           if (errno == EINTR)
76:             {
77:               continue;
78:             }
79: 
80:           return -errno;
81:         }
82: 
83:       if (n == 0)
84:         {
85:           return -EPIPE;
86:         }
87: 
88:       sent += (size_t)n;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return 0;
92: }
93: 
94: /****************************************************************************
95:  * Name: vp_read_request
96:  *
97:  * Description:
98:  *   Read until the headers plus the declared body have arrived, the cap is
99:  *   reached or the deadline passes.  Returns the total length, or negative on
100:  *   error.  A client that opens a connection and says nothing costs one
101:  *   timeout, not the service.
102:  *
103:  ****************************************************************************/
104: 
105: static int vp_read_request(int fd, struct vp_http_request_s *req)
106: {
107:   size_t total = 0;
108:   int waited = 0;
109: 
110:   for (; ; )
111:     {
112:       struct pollfd pfd;
113:       ssize_t n;
114:       int ret;
115: 
116:       ret = vp_http_parse(g_request, total, req);
117:       if (ret == 0)
118:         {
119:           if (req->action != VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE ||
120:               total >= req->header_len + req->content_length)
121:             {
122:               return (int)total;
123:             }
124:         }
125:       else if (ret != -EAGAIN)
126:         {
127:           return ret;
128:         }
129: 
130:       if (total >= sizeof(g_request) - 1)
131:         {
132:           return -E2BIG;
133:         }
134: 
135:       pfd.fd = fd;
136:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
137:       pfd.revents = 0;
138:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
139:       if (ret < 0)
140:         {
141:           if (errno == EINTR)
142:             {
143:               continue;
144:             }
145: 
146:           return -errno;
147:         }
148: 
149:       if (ret == 0)
150:         {
151:           waited += VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS;
152:           if (waited >= VP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
153:             {
154:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
155:             }
156: 
157:           continue;
158:         }
159: 
160:       n = read(fd, g_request + total, sizeof(g_request) - 1 - total);
161:       if (n < 0)
162:         {
163:           if (errno == EINTR)
164:             {
165:               continue;
166:             }
167: 
168:           return -errno;
169:         }
170: 
171:       if (n == 0)
172:         {
173:           /* Peer closed.  Whatever arrived is all there will be, so let the
174:            * parser decide between "incomplete" and "answerable".
175:            */
176: 
177:           if (vp_http_parse(g_request, total, req) == 0 &&
178:               (req->action != VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE ||
179:                total >= req->header_len + req->content_length))
180:             {
181:               return (int)total;
182:             }
183: 
184:           return -ECONNRESET;
185:         }
186: 
187:       total += (size_t)n;
188:     }
189: }
190: 
191: /****************************************************************************
192:  * Name: vp_handle
193:  *
194:  * Description:
195:  *   Serve one connection.  Sets *saved when credentials were persisted and
196:  *   *save_status to 0 or the negative errno of a failed save, so the caller can
197:  *   notify the application only after the socket is gone.
198:  *
199:  ****************************************************************************/
200: 
201: static void vp_handle(int fd, bool *saved, int *save_status,
202:                       uint32_t *generation)
203: {
204:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
205:   struct vp_http_request_s req;
206:   size_t len = 0;
207:   int ret;
208: 
209:   *saved = false;
210:   *save_status = 0;
211: 
212:   ret = vp_read_request(fd, &req);
213:   if (ret < 0)
214:     {
215:       if (ret == -E2BIG)
216:         {
217:           len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 431,
218:                                     "请求过大。");
219:         }
220:       else
221:         {
222:           /* Nothing usable arrived; answering a client that already gave up
223:            * is not worth a second syscall.
224:            */
225: 
226:           return;
227:         }
228:     }
229:   else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE)
230:     {
231:       len = vp_http_form_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), NULL);
232:     }
233:   else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT)
234:     {
235:       len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), req.status,
236:                                req.status == 404 ? "页面不存在。" :
237:                                req.status == 405 ? "不支持该请求方法。" :
238:                                req.status == 413 ? "提交内容过大。" :
239:                                req.status == 415 ? "提交格式不受支持。" :
240:                                req.status == 411 ? "缺少 Content-Length。" :
241:                                                    "请求无法解析。");
242:     }
243:   else
244:     {
245:       memset(&cred, 0, sizeof(cred));
246:       ret = vp_form_parse(g_request + req.header_len, req.content_length,
247:                           &cred);
248:       if (ret < 0)
249:         {
250:           /* No detail about which field failed and no echo of what was typed:
251:            * the notice has to be useful to the person at the phone without
252:            * repeating a passphrase back over an open network.
253:            */
254: 
255:           len = vp_http_form_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
256:                                   "SSID 需 1-32 字节，密码需留空或 8-63 字节，"
257:                                   "请检查后重试。");
258:           if (len > 0)
259:             {
260:               /* Reuse the form page body but answer 400, so a client that
261:                * checks the status still learns the submit failed.
262:                */
263: 
264:               len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 400,
265:                                         "SSID 需 1-32 字节，密码需留空或 "
266:                                         "8-63 字节。");
267:             }
268:         }
269:       else
270:         {
271:           cred.generation = vp_store_next_generation(g_server.store_path);
272:           ret = vp_store_save(g_server.store_path, &cred);
273:           if (ret < 0)
274:             {
275:               *saved = false;
276:               *save_status = ret;
277:               len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 500,
278:                                         "写入持久存储失败，凭据未保存。");
279:             }
280:           else
281:             {
282:               *saved = true;
283:               *save_status = 0;
284:               *generation = cred.generation;
285:               len = vp_http_saved_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
286:                                        cred.ssid, cred.generation,
287:                                        cred.open_network);
288:             }
289:         }
290:     }
291: 
292:   if (len > 0)
293:     {
294:       (void)vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len);
295:     }
296: }
297: 
298: static void *vp_thread(void *arg)
299: {
300:   (void)arg;
301: 
302:   for (; ; )
303:     {
304:       struct pollfd pfd;
305:       uint32_t generation = 0;
306:       int save_status = 0;
307:       bool saved = false;
308:       bool stopping;
309:       int fd;
310:       int ret;
311: 
312:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
313:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
314:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
315:       if (stopping)
316:         {
317:           break;
318:         }
319: 
320:       pfd.fd = g_server.listenfd;
321:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
322:       pfd.revents = 0;
323: 
324:       /* Polling rather than blocking in accept(): stop() then needs no signal
325:        * and no socket shutdown trick that may or may not wake accept on a
326:        * given stack.
327:        *
328:        * This requires CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG on NuttX, which the Kconfig
329:        * depends on.  Without it TCP_BACKLOG events never fire, POLLIN on a
330:        * listening socket is unreachable, and accept() blocks with no timeout
331:        * at all -- measured on the board as a service that reported
332:        * "listening" and then answered nothing.
333:        */
334: 
335:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
336:       if (ret < 0)
337:         {
338:           if (errno == EINTR)
339:             {
340:               continue;
341:             }
342: 
343:           break;
344:         }
345: 
346:       if (ret == 0)
347:         {
348:           continue;
349:         }
350: 
351:       fd = accept(g_server.listenfd, NULL, NULL);
352:       if (fd < 0)
353:         {
354:           if (errno == EINTR || errno == ECONNABORTED)
355:             {
356:               continue;
357:             }
358: 
359:           break;
360:         }
361: 
362:       vp_handle(fd, &saved, &save_status, &generation);
363: 
364:       /* Close before notifying.  The application is expected to leave SoftAP
365:        * from the callback, and doing that with the response still in flight is
366:        * what makes a successful save look like a failed submit on the phone.
367:        */
368: 
369:       shutdown(fd, SHUT_RDWR);
370:       close(fd);
371: 
372:       if (saved)
373:         {
374:           pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
375:           g_server.generation = generation;
376:           pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
377:         }
378: 
379:       if (saved || save_status < 0)
380:         {
381:           if (g_server.on_saved != NULL)
382:             {
383:               g_server.on_saved(save_status, generation, g_server.cb_arg);
384:             }
385:         }
386: 
387:       if (saved && g_server.one_shot)
388:         {
389:           break;
390:         }
391: 
392:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
393:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
394:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
395:       if (stopping)
396:         {
397:           break;
398:         }
399:     }
400: 
401:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
402:   if (g_server.listenfd >= 0)
403:     {
404:       close(g_server.listenfd);
405:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
406:     }
407: 
408:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_FINISHED;
409:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
410:   return NULL;
411: }
412: 
413: /* Caller holds g_lock. */
414: 
415: static void vp_reap_locked(void)
416: {
417:   if (g_server.state == VP_STATE_FINISHED)
418:     {
419:       pthread_t thread = g_server.thread;
420: 
421:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
422:       pthread_join(thread, NULL);
423:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
424:       g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
425:     }
426: }
427: 
428: int velasight_provisioning_start(
429:     const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config)
430: {
431:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
432:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
433:   pthread_attr_t attr;
434:   uint16_t port;
435:   int one = 1;
436:   int fd;
437:   int ret;
438: 
439:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
440:   if (config != NULL)
441:     {
442:       cfg = *config;
443:     }
444: 
445:   if (cfg.store_path != NULL &&
446:       strlen(cfg.store_path) >= VP_STORE_PATH_MAX)
447:     {
448:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
449:     }
450: 
451:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
452:   vp_reap_locked();
453:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_IDLE)
454:     {
455:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
456:       return -EALREADY;
457:     }
458: 
459:   port = cfg.port != 0 ? cfg.port :
460:          (uint16_t)CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT;
461: 
462:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
463:   if (fd < 0)
464:     {
465:       ret = -errno;
466:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
467:       return ret;
468:     }
469: 
470:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &one, sizeof(one));
471: 
472:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
473:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
474:   addr.sin_port        = htons(port);
475:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
476: 
477:   if (bind(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0 ||
478:       listen(fd, 2) < 0)

1: # AP 模式简易配网 Web
2: 
3: 板子进入 SoftAP 后调用一个入口，手机连上热点打开网页填 SSID 和密码，凭据原子写入
4: SD-NAND，应用通过回调知道「第 N 次保存成功」。
5: 
6: **本服务不切换 Wi-Fi 模式。** 不调用 `wapi`、不 `ifup/ifdown`、不关联、不启停 DHCPD。
7: 进 SoftAP 和切回 STA 全部由应用或人工完成——只有应用知道什么时候可以让网络断开。
8: 
9: ## 应用侧用法
10: 
11: ```c
12: #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
13: 
14: static void on_saved(int status, uint32_t generation, void *arg)
15: {
16:   if (status < 0)
17:     {
18:       /* 写盘失败，凭据没存下来 */
19:       return;
20:     }
21: 
22:   /* 页面已经发完、连接已经关闭，这里可以安全地切回 STA */
23:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
24: 
25:   if (velasight_provisioning_load(&cred) == 0)
26:     {
27:       /* cred.ssid / cred.password / cred.open_network */
28:       velasight_provisioning_stop();   /* 从回调里调用是安全的 */
29:       /* 这里做你自己的 STA 切换与关联 */
30:     }
31: }
32: 
33: struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg =
34: {
35:   .port       = 0,          /* 0 → 80 */
36:   .one_shot   = false,      /* true = 成功保存一次后自动停止 */
37:   .store_path = NULL,       /* NULL → CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE */
38:   .on_saved   = on_saved,
39:   .cb_arg     = NULL,
40: };
41: 
42: velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);
43: ```
44: 
45: | 函数 | 说明 |
46: |---|---|
47: | `velasight_provisioning_start(cfg)` | 绑定端口并启动监听线程。已在运行返回 `-EALREADY`；`cfg` 可为 NULL 表示全默认 |
48: | `velasight_provisioning_stop()` | 关闭监听并回收线程。未运行返回 `-EALREADY`。可在回调里调用 |
49: | `velasight_provisioning_is_running()` | 是否在监听 |
50: | `velasight_provisioning_generation()` | 本次运行内成功保存的次数，未保存过为 0 |
51: | `velasight_provisioning_load(out)` | 读取凭据。`-ENOENT` 未配网，`-EBADMSG` 记录损坏 |
52: | `velasight_provisioning_load_from(path, out)` | 指定路径读取 |
53: 
54: 回调只带状态码和序号，不带凭据：要凭据请显式 `load()`，这样密码不会顺着每一个只想收
55: 通知的回调链路走一遍。回调固定在**响应发完并关闭连接之后**触发——反过来会在应用切走
56: Wi-Fi 时截断响应，手机上看到的是「提交失败」而实际已经存了。
57: 
58: 监听线程是 pthread，pthread 不会比创建它的任务活得更久，所以应用要在自己的长驻任务里
59: 调 `start()`。
60: 
61: ## 手工上板验证
62: 
63: 先切 SoftAP（详见 `docs/WiFi使用说明.md`）：
64: 
65: ```sh
66: ifdown wlan0
67: ifup wlan0
68: wapi mode wlan0 3
69: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
70: wapi psk wlan0 <8-63字节密码> 3
71: wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
72: dhcpd_start wlan0            # 板子成为 192.168.10.1
73: ```
74: 
75: 再起配网页面：
76: 
77: ```sh
78: provision_web run            # 前台运行，Ctrl-C 停止
79: provision_web run 8080       # 换端口
80: provision_web run --one-shot # 成功保存一次后返回
81: ```
82: 
83: 手机连上 `VelaSight_AP` 后浏览器打开 `http://192.168.10.1/`，填 SSID 和密码提交。
84: 
85: 查看已存内容（**不打印密码**）：
86: 
87: ```sh
88: provision_web show
89: # provision_web: ssid=AIPC security=wpa2 password=set generation=1
90: provision_web path
91: # /mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin
92: ```
93: 
94: 没有手机或 Wi-Fi 客户端时，用板子自己的回环把整条链路走一遍（会用测试网络覆盖已存
95: 记录，不需要进 SoftAP）：
96: 
97: ```sh
98: provision_web selftest
99: # provision_web selftest: PASS, 14 checks, 0 failures
100: reboot
101: provision_web show      # 证明记录跨重启存活
102: ```
103: 
104: 验完切回 STA，仍然按 `docs/WiFi使用说明.md`：
105: 
106: ```sh
107: dhcpd_stop
108: ifdown wlan0
109: ifup wlan0
110: wapi mode wlan0 2
111: wapi psk wlan0 <路由器密码> 3
112: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
113: renew wlan0
114: ```
115: 
116: ## HTTP 表面
117: 
118: | 请求 | 响应 |
119: |---|---|
120: | `GET /`、`GET /index.html` | 200 表单页 |
121: | `POST /save`（`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`） | 200 成功页 / 400 校验失败 / 500 写盘失败 |
122: | 其他方法 | 405 |
123: | 其他路径 | 404 |
124: | 缺 `Content-Length` | 411 |
125: | body > 512 字节 | 413 |
126: | 非表单 Content-Type | 415 |
127: | 请求头 > 2048 字节 | 431 |
128: | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` | 400 |
129: 
130: 读超时 5 秒，一次只服务一个连接，每个连接答完即关闭。成功页只回显经过 HTML 转义的
131: SSID；**密码永不回显、永不进日志**。
132: 
133: 校验规则：SSID 1–32 字节且不含控制字符；密码留空表示开放网络，否则必须 8–63 字节的
134: 可打印 ASCII。表单缺 `ssid` 直接 400；`ssid` 或 `password` 重复出现按歧义拒绝，不猜。
135: 
136: ## NAND 记录
137: 
138: 默认 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin`，固定 114 字节，小端：
139: 
140: | 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |
141: |---|---|---|
142: | 0 | 4 | 魔数 `VSWP` |
143: | 4 | 2 | 版本，当前 1 |
144: | 6 | 2 | 标志位，bit0 = 开放网络 |
145: | 8 | 4 | generation |
146: | 12 | 1 | ssid_len，1..32 |
147: | 13 | 1 | psk_len，0 或 8..63 |
148: | 14 | 32 | SSID，补零 |
149: | 46 | 63 | 密码，补零 |
150: | 109 | 1 | 保留，必须 0 |
151: | 110 | 4 | CRC32（IEEE，覆盖 0..109） |
152: 
153: 落盘顺序是同目录的 `vpsave.tmp` → `fflush` → `fsync` → `close` → `rename` → `sync()`。
154: 若目标文件缺失但 scratch 是完整且 CRC 有效的记录，下一次读取会先将 scratch 提升为正式
155: 记录；损坏 scratch 按 `-EBADMSG` 拒绝，不会被提升。
156: 魔数、版本、两个长度、开放标志与 `psk_len` 的自洽性、补零区、保留字节和 CRC 逐项校验，
157: 任何一项不过按 `-EBADMSG` 处理，不做「尽力恢复」。
158: 
159: 只保留最新一份，提交即替换，generation 递增。凭据不镜像到 kvdb——需要的话由应用读出后
160: 自己写。
161: 
162: ## 三条平台约束（都是上板实测撞出来的）
163: 
164: 改动这三处之前先读这一节，否则会重现同样的故障：
165: 
166: 1. **`/mnt` 必须保持伪文件系统。** PSRAM ramdisk 挂在 `/mnt/ram`，不是 `/mnt`。
167:    NuttX 不允许在真实文件系统内部再挂载，`/mnt` 上挂了 littlefs 之后 SD-NAND 的
168:    `/mnt/sdnand` 会以 `-ENOTDIR` 挂载失败，持久存储静默消失。
169: 2. **`CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG=y` 是必需项。** 没有它 listening socket 上不会有
170:    `POLLIN`，`accept()` 也无超时，可停止的监听线程无法实现；症状是打印了 listening
171:    之后什么都不回。本模块 Kconfig 已 `depends on` 它，配置错误会在编译期暴露。
172: 3. **SD-NAND 是不带长名的 VFAT。** `CONFIG_FAT_LFN` 未开，路径每一段必须符合 8.3。
173:    `velasight/`、`wifi-provision.bin` 都会被 `-EINVAL` 拒绝，把 `.tmp` 追加到
174:    `wifi.bin` 得到两个点也非法——所以临时文件是固定名 `vpsave.tmp`。主机测试会逐段
175:    校验默认路径的 8.3 合规性。
176: 
177: VFAT 上 `rename` 不是单步原子：NuttX 的 VFS 先 unlink 目标，FAT 的 `rename` 拒绝覆盖。
178: 所以存在「旧记录已删、新记录未就位」的极短窗口，此时读到 `-ENOENT`；读不到截断记录，
179: 因为长度和 CRC 都会拒绝。

73: ## SoftAP 模式
74: 
75: 以下配置已在 BK7258 实板验证手机可发现并连接热点：
76: 
77: ```sh
78: ifdown wlan0
79: ifup wlan0
80: wapi mode wlan0 3
81: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
82: wapi psk wlan0 12345678 3
83: wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
84: dhcpd_start wlan0
85: ```
86: 
87: 其中：
88: 
89: - `3` 表示 `WAPI_MODE_MASTER` 或 WPA-CCMP。
90: - channel 固定为 6，可按现场 2.4 GHz 信道占用改为 1 至 13。
91: - WPA2 密码必须为 8 至 63 字节。
92: - `dhcpd_start` 会将板端配置为 `192.168.10.1/24`。
93: - DHCP 地址池为 `192.168.10.2` 起，最多分配 4 个租约。
94: 
95: 检查运行状态：
96: 
97: ```sh
98: ifconfig wlan0
99: wapi show wlan0
100: ```
101: 
102: 成功时 `ifconfig` 必须显示 `RUNNING`，`wapi show` 应显示
103: `WAPI_MODE_MASTER`、目标 ESSID、channel 和 AP MAC。只有 `UP` 而没有
104: `RUNNING` 表示配置已保存，但 CP 尚未成功启动 beacon。
105: 
106: 手机连接：
107: 
108: ```text
109: SSID: VelaSight_AP
110: 密码: 12345678
111: IP 设置: DHCP/自动
112: ```
113: 
114: 停止 SoftAP：
115: 
116: ```sh
117: dhcpd_stop
118: ifdown wlan0
119: ```
120: 
121: 切回 STA：
122: 
123: ```sh
124: ifup wlan0
125: wapi mode wlan0 2
126: wapi psk wlan0 <路由器密码> 3
127: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
128: renew wlan0
129: ifconfig wlan0
130: ```
131: 
132: ## 故障排查
133: 
134: - `dhcpd_start: command not found`：当前 AP 分区不是启用 SoftAP DHCP 的最新
135:   `nsh` 镜像。`help` 的 `Builtin Apps` 必须包含 `dhcpd_start` 和 `dhcpd_stop`。
136: - 手机扫描不到热点：先检查 `ifconfig wlan0` 是否为 `RUNNING`；`wapi show`
137:   只能证明配置已保存，不能单独证明热点已经发 beacon。
138: - 重复启动 DHCP 前先执行 `dhcpd_stop`，避免旧服务仍占用 UDP 端口 67。
139: - SoftAP 模式不支持与 STA 并发；切换角色前必须停止当前角色。
140: 
141: ## 注意
142: 
143: - 不要把真实 Wi-Fi 密码提交到仓库或测试日志中。开放热点不涉及这个问题。
144: - 示例 SoftAP 密码仅用于开发测试，产品使用时必须替换。
145: - 当前的 HTTPS 是加密但未验证证书的（无 RTC/SNTP，且 `VERIFY_OPTIONAL`），详见
146:   `docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md` 第 7 节。

5:  * SoftAP itself, calls velasight_provisioning_start(), and gets told when a
6:  * phone has submitted credentials.  This service never touches the Wi-Fi
7:  * role: it does not associate, does not run wapi, does not start DHCPD and
8:  * does not switch back to STA.  Owning both the HTTP page and the radio would
9:  * make it impossible for the application to decide when the network may drop.

12:  ****************************************************************************/
13:

21: #ifdef __cplusplus
22: extern "C"
23: {

31: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN  8
32: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX  63
33: 
34: /* Where the record lives when the caller passes no path.  On SD-NAND, so it
35:  * survives a reset; /mnt itself is pseudo-filesystem and /mnt/ram is a PSRAM
36:  * ramdisk, neither of which would.
37:  *
38:  * Every component fits 8.3 because that SD-NAND is VFAT without long-name
39:  * support (CONFIG_FAT_LFN is not set): a "velasight" directory or a
40:  * "wifi-provision.bin" file is rejected outright with -EINVAL.
41:  */
42: 
43: #ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE
44: #  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE "/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin"
45: #endif
46:

48: #  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT 80
49: #endif

52: {
53:   char     ssid[VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX + 1];
54:   char     password[VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX + 1];

66:  * not travel through every callback that only wanted the notification.
67:  */

69: typedef void (*velasight_prov_saved_cb_t)(int status, uint32_t generation,
70:                                           void *arg);

72: struct velasight_prov_config_s

75:   bool                      one_shot;   /* Stop after one accepted submit */
76:   const char               *store_path; /* NULL selects the built-in path */

161:  * Description:
162:  *   Drive the service over loopback on the board itself.  The host tests
163:  *   already cover the parsing and the record; what only the board can answer

169:  *   passphrase below is a fixed test string, never a real one.
170:  *

173: #define PROV_TEST_PORT 18080
174: #define PROV_TEST_SSID "VelaSightProvTest"
175: #define PROV_TEST_PSK  "selftest-pass"

177: static int g_selftest_checks;
178: static int g_selftest_failures;
179: static volatile int g_selftest_cb_status = 1;
180: static volatile uint32_t g_selftest_cb_generation;

182: static void provision_check(bool ok, const char *what)
183: {

194:                                      void *arg)

201: static int provision_exchange(const char *request, char *reply,
202:                               size_t replylen)
203: {
204:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
205:   struct timeval tv;
206:   size_t total = 0;
207:   int fd;
208: 
209:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
210:   if (fd < 0)
211:     {
212:       return -errno;
213:     }
214: 
215:   tv.tv_sec  = 5;
216:   tv.tv_usec = 0;
217:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
218:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
219: 
220:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
221:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
222:   addr.sin_port        = htons(PROV_TEST_PORT);
223:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
224: 
225:   if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0)
226:     {
227:       int error = -errno;
228: 
229:       close(fd);
230:       return error;
231:     }
232: 
233:   if (write(fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0)
234:     {
235:       int error = -errno;
236: 
237:       close(fd);
238:       return error;
239:     }
240: 
241:   for (; ; )
242:     {
243:       ssize_t n = read(fd, reply + total, replylen - 1 - total);
244: 
245:       if (n <= 0)
246:         {
247:           break;
248:         }
249: 
250:       total += (size_t)n;
251:       if (total >= replylen - 1)
252:         {
253:           break;
254:         }
255:     }
256: 
257:   close(fd);
258:   reply[total] = '\0';
259:   return (int)total;
260: }

262: static int provision_selftest(void)
263: {
264:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
265:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
266:   static char reply[2048];
267:   int waited;
268:   int ret;

270:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
271:   cfg.port     = PROV_TEST_PORT;
272:   cfg.on_saved = provision_selftest_saved;

274:   /* NuttX keeps this app's statics between invocations of the builtin, so a
275:    * second `provision_web selftest` would otherwise start with the previous
276:    * run's callback status already at 0 -- a pass inherited rather than
277:    * observed -- and report accumulated check counts.
278:    */

1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: 
3: set -euo pipefail
4: 
5: SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
6: CONTEST_ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd -P)
7: SDK_ROOT="$CONTEST_ROOT/bk_avdk_smp"
8: OPENVELA_ROOT="$CONTEST_ROOT/contest"
9: AP_CONFIG="vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/ai_agent"
10: AP_OUT="$OPENVELA_ROOT/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent"
11: PACKAGE="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
12: AP_BIN="$AP_OUT/nuttx.bin"
13: AP_INPUT="$SDK_ROOT/build/openvela-ap.bin"
14: AP_PACKED="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin"
15: LOG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/runtime"
16: 
17: PORT=${VELASIGHT_PORT:-/dev/ttyUSB0}
18: PORT_NUM=${VELASIGHT_PORT_NUM:-}
19: FLASH_BAUD=${VELASIGHT_FLASH_BAUD:-1500000}
20: CONSOLE_BAUD=${VELASIGHT_CONSOLE_BAUD:-115200}
21: BOOT_LOG_SECONDS=${VELASIGHT_BOOT_LOG_SECONDS:-25}
22: DO_FLASH=0
23: 
24: die()
25: {
26:   printf 'error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
27:   exit 1
28: }
29: 
30: usage()
31: {
32:   printf '%s\n' \
33:     'usage: build_and_flash.sh [--flash] [-p port] [-n loader-port]' \
34:     '       [--boot-log-seconds seconds]' \
35:     'Builds ai_agent, regenerates the 4148K-aligned AP layout, packages all-app.bin,' \
36:     'and optionally flashes it with the shell-based autoflash workflow.'
37: }
38: 
39: while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
40:   case "$1" in
41:     --flash) DO_FLASH=1 ;;
42:     -p) shift; PORT=$1 ;;
43:     -n) shift; PORT_NUM=$1 ;;
44:     --boot-log-seconds) shift; BOOT_LOG_SECONDS=$1 ;;
45:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
46:     *) die "unknown argument: $1" ;;
47:   esac
48:   shift
49: done
50: 
51: command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'podman is required'
52: command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'sha256sum is required'
53: command -v cmp >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'cmp is required'
54: 
55: cd "$OPENVELA_ROOT"
56: ./build.sh "$AP_CONFIG" --cmake distclean
57: ./build.sh "$AP_CONFIG" --cmake -j8
58: 
59: test -s "$AP_BIN" || die "missing AP binary: $AP_BIN"
60: grep -q '^CONFIG_LV_TXT_ENC_UTF8=y$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'UTF-8 is disabled'
61: grep -q '^CONFIG_LV_FONT_FMT_TXT_LARGE=y$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'large LVGL font format is disabled'
62: grep -q '^CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS=500$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'short-press limit is not 500 ms'
63: grep -q 'velasight_font_16_ui' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'UI font is not linked'
64: grep -q -- '--range 0x4e00-0x9fff' "$SCRIPT_DIR/app/velasight/velasight_font_16_ui.c" || die 'full CJK font range is missing'
65: grep -q 'voice_vad_process' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'VAD is not linked'
66: grep -q 'velaclaw_client_open' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'local ai_agent client is not linked'
67: 
68: AP_SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$AP_BIN")
69: AP_LIMIT=$((3904 * 1024))
70: [ "$AP_SIZE" -le "$AP_LIMIT" ] || die "AP binary exceeds 3904K raw linker region: $AP_SIZE > $AP_LIMIT"
71: 
72: mkdir -p "$(dirname -- "$AP_INPUT")"
73: cp -- "$AP_BIN" "$AP_INPUT"
74: 
75: cd "$SDK_ROOT"
76: make -C projects/app_ab clean
77: podman run --rm --userns=keep-id \
78:   -v "$SDK_ROOT:/armino" \
79:   -w /armino \
80:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
81:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
82:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
83:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
84: 
85: PARTITIONS="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/partitions.txt"
86: test -s "$PACKAGE" || die 'all-app.bin is missing'
87: test -s "$AP_PACKED" || die 'packed AP input is missing'
88: grep -q 'primary_ap_app.*4148K' "$PARTITIONS" || die 'AP partition is not 4148K'
89: cmp -s "$AP_BIN" "$AP_INPUT" || die 'external AP copy differs'
90: cmp -s "$AP_BIN" "$AP_PACKED" || die 'packed AP input differs'
91: 
92: IMAGE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$PACKAGE")
93: IMAGE_SHA=$(sha256sum -- "$PACKAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
94: 
95: if [ "$DO_FLASH" -eq 1 ]; then
96:   cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"
97:   FLASH_ARGS=(-b "$FLASH_BAUD" -B "$CONSOLE_BAUD" -p "$PORT")
98:   if [ -n "$PORT_NUM" ]; then
99:     FLASH_ARGS+=(-n "$PORT_NUM")
100:   fi
101:   AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE="$IMAGE_SIZE" \
102:     ./autoflash.sh "${FLASH_ARGS[@]}"
103: 
104:   mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
105:   BOOT_LOG="$LOG_DIR/velasight-final-boot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
106:   stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts
107:   timeout --foreground "$BOOT_LOG_SECONDS" tee "$BOOT_LOG" < "$PORT" >/dev/null &
108:   CAPTURE_PID=$!
109:   sleep 0.5
110:   printf '\035' > "$PORT"
111:   sleep 0.05
112:   printf '.' > "$PORT"
113:   sleep 0.05
114:   printf '\r\n' > "$PORT"
115:   sleep 0.05
116:   printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT"
117:   wait "$CAPTURE_PID" || true
118:   printf 'boot log: %s\n' "$BOOT_LOG"
119:   tr '\r' '\n' < "$BOOT_LOG" | tee "${BOOT_LOG%.log}.normalized.log"
120: fi

408: /****************************************************************************
409:  * Name: dhcpd_setlease
410:  ****************************************************************************/
411: 
412: struct lease_s *dhcpd_setlease(const uint8_t *mac,
413:                                in_addr_t ipaddr, time_t expiry)
414: {
415:   /* Calculate the offset from the first IP address managed by DHCPD.
416:    * ipaddr must be in host order!
417:    */
418: 
419:   int ndx = ipaddr - g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip;
420:   struct lease_s *ret = NULL;
421: 
422:   ninfo("ipaddr: %08" PRIx32 " ipaddr: %08" PRIx32 " ndx: %d MAX: %d\n",
423:         (uint32_t)ipaddr, (uint32_t)g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip, ndx,
424:         CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MAXLEASES);
425: 
426:   /* Verify that the address offset is within the supported range */
427: 
428:   if (ndx >= 0 && ndx < CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MAXLEASES)
429:     {
430:        ret = &g_state.ds_leases[ndx];
431:        memcpy(ret->mac, mac, DHCP_HLEN_ETHERNET);
432:        ret->allocated = true;
433: #ifdef HAVE_LEASE_TIME
434:        ret->expiry = dhcpd_time() + expiry;
435: #endif
436:     }
437: 
438:   return ret;
439: }

445: static inline in_addr_t dhcp_leaseipaddr(FAR struct lease_s *lease)
446: {
447:   /* Return IP address in host order */
448: 
449:   return (in_addr_t)(lease - g_state.ds_leases) +
450:          g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip;
451: }

457: static FAR struct lease_s *dhcpd_findbymac(FAR const uint8_t *mac)
458: {
459:   int i;

461:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MAXLEASES; i++)
462:     {
463:       if (memcmp(g_state.ds_leases[i].mac, mac, DHCP_HLEN_ETHERNET) == 0)
464:         {
465:           return &(g_state.ds_leases[i]);
466:         }
467:     }

472: /****************************************************************************
473:  * Name: dhcpd_findbyipaddr
474:  ****************************************************************************/
475: 
476: static FAR struct lease_s *dhcpd_findbyipaddr(in_addr_t ipaddr)
477: {
478:   if (ipaddr >= g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip &&
479:       ipaddr <= g_dhcpd_config.ds_endip)
480:     {
481:       FAR struct lease_s *lease =
482:         &g_state.ds_leases[ipaddr - g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip];
483:       if (lease->allocated > 0)
484:         {
485:           return lease;
486:         }
487:     }
488: 
489:   return NULL;
490: }

492: /****************************************************************************
493:  * Name: dhcpd_allocipaddr
494:  ****************************************************************************/
495: 
496: static in_addr_t dhcpd_allocipaddr(void)
497: {
498:   struct lease_s *lease = NULL;
499:   in_addr_t ipaddr, startaddr;
500: 
501:   ipaddr = startaddr = g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip;
502:   for (; ipaddr <= g_dhcpd_config.ds_endip; ipaddr++)
503:     {
504:       /* Skip over address ending in 0 or 255 */
505: 
506:       if ((ipaddr & 0xff) == 0 || (ipaddr & 0xff) == 0xff)
507:         {
508:           continue;
509:         }
510: 
511:       /* Is there already a lease on this address?  If so, has it expired? */
512: 
513:       lease = dhcpd_findbyipaddr(ipaddr);
514:       if ((!lease || dhcpd_leaseexpired(lease)))
515:         {
516: #ifdef CONFIG_CPP_HAVE_WARNING
517: #  warning "FIXME: Should check if anything responds to an ARP request or ping"
518: #  warning "       to verify that there is no other user of this IP address"
519: #endif
520:           memset(g_state.ds_leases[ipaddr - startaddr].mac,
521:           0, DHCP_HLEN_ETHERNET);
522:           g_state.ds_leases[ipaddr - startaddr].allocated = true;
523: #ifdef HAVE_LEASE_TIME
524:           g_state.ds_leases[ipaddr - startaddr].expiry =
525:             dhcpd_time() + CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_OFFERTIME;
526: #endif
527:           /* Return the address in host order */
528: 
529:           return ipaddr;
530:         }
531:     }
532: 
533:   return 0;
534: }

536: /****************************************************************************
537:  * Name: dhcpd_parseoptions
538:  ****************************************************************************/
539: 
540: static inline bool dhcpd_parseoptions(void)
541: {
542:   uint32_t tmp;
543:   uint8_t *ptr;
544: #ifndef CONFIG_NET_DHCP_LIGHT
545:   uint8_t overloaded;
546:   uint8_t currfield;
547: #endif
548:   int optlen = 0;
549:   int remaining;
550: 
551:   /* Verify that the option field starts with a valid magic number */
552: 
553:   ptr = g_state.ds_inpacket.options;
554:   if (memcmp(ptr, g_magiccookie, 4) != 0)
555:     {
556:       /* Bad magic number... skip g_state.ds_outpacket */
557: 
558:       nerr("ERROR: Bad magic: %d,%d,%d,%d\n",
559:            ptr[0], ptr[1], ptr[2], ptr[3]);
560:       return false;
561:     }
562: 
563:   /* Set up to parse the options */
564: 
565:   ptr       += 4;
566:   remaining  = DHCPD_OPTIONS_SIZE - 4;
567: #ifndef CONFIG_NET_DHCP_LIGHT
568:   overloaded = DHCPD_OPTION_FIELD;
569:   currfield  = DHCPD_OPTION_FIELD;
570: #endif
571: 
572:   /* Set all options to the default value */
573: 
574:   g_state.ds_optmsgtype   = 0;    /* Incoming DHCP message type */
575:   g_state.ds_optreqip     = 0;    /* Requested IP address (host order) */
576:   g_state.ds_optserverip  = 0;    /* Serverip IP address (host order) */
577:   g_state.ds_optleasetime = 0;    /* Requested lease time (host order) */
578:   g_state.ds_optend       = NULL;
579: 
580:   do
581:     {
582:       /* The form of an option is:
583:        *   code   - 1 byte
584:        *   length - 1 byte
585:        *   data   - variable number of bytes
586:        */
587: 
588:       switch (ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_CODE])
589:         {
590:           /* Skip over any padding bytes */
591: 
592:           case DHCP_OPTION_PAD:
593:             optlen = 1;
594:             break;
595: 
596:           /* the Overload option is used to indicate that the DHCP 'sname'
597:            * or 'file' fields are being overloaded by using them to carry
598:            * DHCP options. A DHCP server inserts this option if the
599:            * returned parameters will exceed the usual space allotted for
600:            * options.
601:            *
602:            * If this option is present, the client interprets the specified
603:            * additional fields after it concludes interpretation of the
604:            * standard option fields.
605:            *
606:            * Legal values for this option are:
607:            *
608:            *   1     the 'file' field is used to hold options
609:            *   2     the 'sname' field is used to hold options
610:            *   3     both fields are used to hold options
611:            */
612: 
613: #ifndef CONFIG_NET_DHCP_LIGHT
614:           case DHCP_OPTION_OVERLOAD:
615:             optlen = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
616:             if (optlen >= 3 && optlen < remaining)
617:               {
618:                 overloaded = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_DATA];
619:               }
620:             break;
621: #endif
622: 
623:           case DHCP_OPTION_END:
624: #ifndef CONFIG_NET_DHCP_LIGHT
625:             if (currfield == DHCPD_OPTION_FIELD &&
626:                 (overloaded & DHCPD_FILE_FIELD) != 0)
627:               {
628:                 ptr       = g_state.ds_inpacket.file;
629:                 remaining = sizeof(g_state.ds_inpacket.file);
630:                 currfield = DHCPD_FILE_FIELD;
631:               }
632:             else if (currfield == DHCPD_FILE_FIELD &&
633:                      (overloaded & DHCPD_SNAME_FIELD) != 0)
634:               {
635:                 ptr       = g_state.ds_inpacket.sname;
636:                 remaining = sizeof(g_state.ds_inpacket.sname);
637:                 currfield = DHCPD_SNAME_FIELD;
638:               }
639:             else
640:               {
641:                 return true;
642:               }
643:             break;
644: #else
645:             return true;
646: #endif
647: 
648:           case DHCP_OPTION_REQ_IPADDR: /* Requested IP Address */
649:             optlen = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
650:             if (optlen >= 6 && optlen < remaining)
651:               {
652:                 memcpy(&tmp, &ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_DATA], 4);
653:                 g_state.ds_optreqip = (in_addr_t)ntohl(tmp);
654:               }
655:             break;
656: 
657:           case DHCP_OPTION_LEASE_TIME: /* IP address lease time */
658:              optlen = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
659:             if (optlen >= 6 && optlen < remaining)
660:               {
661:                 memcpy(&tmp, &ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_DATA], 4);
662:                 g_state.ds_optleasetime = (time_t)ntohl(tmp);
663:               }
664:             break;
665: 
666:          case DHCP_OPTION_MSG_TYPE: /* DHCP message type */
667:             optlen = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
668:             if (optlen >= 3 && optlen < remaining)
669:               {
670:                 g_state.ds_optmsgtype = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_DATA];
671:               }
672:             break;
673: 
674:           case DHCP_OPTION_SERVER_ID: /* Server identifier */
675:             optlen = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
676:             if (optlen >= 6 && optlen < remaining)
677:               {
678:                 memcpy(&tmp, &ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_DATA], 4);
679:                 g_state.ds_optserverip = (in_addr_t)ntohl(tmp);
680:               }
681:             break;
682: 
683:           default:
684: 
685:             /* Skip over unsupported options */
686: 
687:             optlen = ptr[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
688:             break;
689:         }
690: 
691:       /* Advance to the next option */
692: 
693:       ptr       += optlen;
694:       remaining -= optlen;
695:     }
696:   while (remaining > 0);
697: 
698:   return false;
699: }

701: /****************************************************************************
702:  * Name: dhcpd_verifyreqip
703:  ****************************************************************************/
704: 
705: static inline bool dhcpd_verifyreqip(void)
706: {
707:   struct lease_s *lease;
708: 
709:   /* Verify that the requested IP address is within the supported lease
710:    * range
711:    */
712: 
713:   if (g_state.ds_optreqip >= g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip &&
714:       g_state.ds_optreqip <= g_dhcpd_config.ds_endip)
715:     {
716:       /* And verify that the lease has not already been taken or offered
717:        * (unless the lease/offer is expired, then the address is free game).
718:        */
719: 
720:       lease = dhcpd_findbyipaddr(g_state.ds_optreqip);
721:       if (!lease || dhcpd_leaseexpired(lease))
722:         {
723:           return true;
724:         }
725:     }
726: 
727:   return false;
728: }

730: /****************************************************************************
731:  * Name: dhcpd_verifyreqleasetime
732:  ****************************************************************************/
733: 
734: static inline bool dhcpd_verifyreqleasetime(uint32_t *leasetime)
735: {
736:   uint32_t tmp = g_state.ds_optleasetime;
737: 
738:   /* Did the client request a specific lease time? */
739: 
740:   if (tmp != 0)
741:     {
742:       /* Yes..  Verify that the requested lease time is within a
743:        * valid range
744:        */
745: 
746:       if (tmp > CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MAXLEASETIME)
747:         {
748:           tmp = CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MAXLEASETIME;
749:         }
750:       else if (tmp < CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MINLEASETIME)
751:         {
752:           tmp = CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MINLEASETIME;
753:         }
754: 
755:       /* Return the clipped lease time */
756: 
757:       *leasetime = tmp;
758:       return true;
759:     }
760: 
761:   return false;
762: }

769: {
770:   int offset;
771:   int len = 4;
772: 
773:   if (g_state.ds_optend)
774:     {
775:       offset = g_state.ds_optend - g_state.ds_outpacket.options;
776:       len    = option[DHCPD_OPTION_LENGTH] + 2;
777: 
778:       /* Check if the option will fit into the options array */
779: 
780:       if (offset + len + 1 < DHCPD_OPTIONS_SIZE)
781:         {
782:           /* Copy the option into the option array */
783: 
784:           memcpy(g_state.ds_optend, option, len);
785:           g_state.ds_optend += len;
786:          *g_state.ds_optend  = DHCP_OPTION_END;
787:         }
788:     }
789: 
790:   return len;
791: }

852: /****************************************************************************
853:  * Name: dhcpd_socket
854:  ****************************************************************************/
855: 
856: static inline int dhcpd_socket(FAR const char *interface)
857: {
858:   int sockfd;
859: #if defined(HAVE_SO_REUSEADDR) || defined(HAVE_SO_BROADCAST)
860:   int optval;
861:   int ret;
862: #endif
863: 
864:   /* Create a socket to listen for requests from DHCP clients */
865: 
866:   sockfd = socket(PF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
867:   if (sockfd < 0)
868:     {
869:       nerr("ERROR: socket failed: %d\n", errno);
870:       return ERROR;
871:     }
872: 
873:   /* Configure the socket */
874: 
875: #ifdef HAVE_SO_REUSEADDR
876:   optval = 1;
877:   ret = setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, (FAR void *)&optval,
878:                    sizeof(int));
879:   if (ret < 0)
880:     {
881:       nerr("ERROR: setsockopt SO_REUSEADDR failed: %d\n", errno);
882:       close(sockfd);
883:       return ERROR;
884:     }
885: #endif
886: 
887: #ifdef HAVE_SO_BROADCAST
888:   optval = 1;
889:   ret = setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, (FAR void *)&optval,
890:                    sizeof(int));
891:   if (ret < 0)
892:     {
893:       nerr("ERROR: setsockopt SO_BROADCAST failed: %d\n", errno);
894:       close(sockfd);
895:       return ERROR;
896:     }
897: #endif
898: 
899: #ifdef CONFIG_NET_BINDTODEVICE
900:   /* Bind socket to interface, because UDP packets have to be sent to the
901:    * broadcast address at a moment when it is not possible to decide the
902:    * target network device using the local or remote address (which is,
903:    * by definition and purpose of DHCP, undefined yet).
904:    */
905: 
906:   if (setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BINDTODEVICE,
907:                  interface, strlen(interface)) < 0)
908:     {
909:       ninfo("ERROR: setsockopt SO_BINDTODEVICE failed: %d\n", errno);
910:       close(sockfd);
911:       return ERROR;
912:     }
913: #endif
914: 
915:   return sockfd;
916: }

918: /****************************************************************************
919:  * Name: dhcpd_initpacket
920:  ****************************************************************************/
921: 
922: static void dhcpd_initpacket(uint8_t mtype)
923: {
924:   uint32_t nulladdr = 0;
925: 
926:   /* Set up the generic parts of the DHCP server message */
927: 
928:   memset(&g_state.ds_outpacket, 0, sizeof(struct dhcpmsg_s));
929: 
930:   g_state.ds_outpacket.op         = DHCP_REPLY;
931:   g_state.ds_outpacket.htype      = g_state.ds_inpacket.htype;
932:   g_state.ds_outpacket.hlen       = g_state.ds_inpacket.hlen;
933: 
934:   memcpy(&g_state.ds_outpacket.xid, &g_state.ds_inpacket.xid, 4);
935:   memcpy(g_state.ds_outpacket.chaddr, g_state.ds_inpacket.chaddr, 16);
936: 
937:   if (memcmp(g_state.ds_outpacket.giaddr, &nulladdr, 4) != 0)
938:     {
939:       g_state.ds_outpacket.flags  = g_state.ds_inpacket.flags;
940:     }
941: 
942:   /* Add the generic options */
943: 
944:   memcpy(g_state.ds_outpacket.options, g_magiccookie, 4);
945:   g_state.ds_optend = &g_state.ds_outpacket.options[4];
946:  *g_state.ds_optend = DHCP_OPTION_END;
947:   dhcpd_addoption8(DHCP_OPTION_MSG_TYPE, mtype);
948:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_SERVER_ID, g_state.ds_serverip);
949: }

951: /****************************************************************************
952:  * Name: dhcpd_sendpacket
953:  ****************************************************************************/
954: 
955: static int dhcpd_sendpacket(int sockfd, int bbroadcast)
956: {
957:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
958:   in_addr_t ipaddr;
959:   int len;
960: 
961: #ifdef CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_IGNOREBROADCAST
962:   /* This is a hack.  I've had problems with Windows machines responding
963:    * to unicast.  I think this is associated with a Windows registry key in
964:    * HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\
965:    * SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\DHCPServer\Parameters:
966:    * The IgnoreBroadcastFlag value controls this behavior:  A value of 1 will
967:    * cause the server to ignore the client broadcast flag and always respond
968:    * with multicast; the value 0 to allows clients to request unicast.
969:    */
970: 
971:   ipaddr = INADDR_BROADCAST;
972: #else
973:   const uint8_t anyipaddr[4] =
974:   {
975:   };
976: 
977:   /* Determine which address to respond to (or if we need to broadcast the
978:    * response)
979:    *
980:    * (1) If he caller know that it needs to multicast the response, it will
981:    *     set broadcast.
982:    * (2) Otherwise, if the client already has and address (ciaddr), then use
983:    *     that for unicast
984:    * (3) Broadcast if the client says it can't handle uni-cast
985:    *     (BOOTP_BROADCAST set)
986:    * (4) Otherwise, the client claims it can handle the uni-casst response
987:    *     and we will uni-cast to the offered address (yiaddr).
988:    *
989:    * NOTE: We really should also check the giaddr field.  If no zero, the
990:    * server should send any return messages to the 'DHCP server' port on the
991:    *  BOOTP relay agent whose address appears in 'giaddr'.
992:    */
993: 
994:   if (bbroadcast)
995:     {
996:       ipaddr = INADDR_BROADCAST;
997:     }
998:   else if (memcmp(g_state.ds_outpacket.ciaddr, anyipaddr, 4) != 0)
999:     {
1000:       dhcpd_arpupdate(g_state.ds_outpacket.ciaddr,
1001:                       g_state.ds_outpacket.chaddr);
1002:       memcpy(&ipaddr, g_state.ds_outpacket.ciaddr, 4);
1003:     }
1004:   else if (g_state.ds_outpacket.flags & HTONS(BOOTP_BROADCAST))
1005:     {
1006:       ipaddr = INADDR_BROADCAST;
1007:     }
1008:   else
1009:     {
1010:       dhcpd_arpupdate(g_state.ds_outpacket.yiaddr,
1011:                       g_state.ds_outpacket.chaddr);
1012:       memcpy(&ipaddr, g_state.ds_outpacket.yiaddr, 4);
1013:     }
1014: #endif
1015: 
1016:   /* Create a socket to respond with a packet to the client.  We
1017:    * cannot re-use the listener socket because it is not bound correctly
1018:    */
1019: 
1020:   /* Then send the response to the DHCP client port at that address */
1021: 
1022:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(struct sockaddr_in));
1023:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
1024:   addr.sin_port        = HTONS(DHCP_CLIENT_PORT);
1025:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = ipaddr;
1026: 
1027:   /* Send the minimum sized packet that includes the END option */
1028: 
1029:   len = (g_state.ds_optend - (FAR uint8_t *)&g_state.ds_outpacket) + 1;
1030:   ninfo("sendto %08lx:%04x len=%d\n",
1031:         (long)ntohl(addr.sin_addr.s_addr), ntohs(addr.sin_port), len);
1032: 
1033:   return sendto(sockfd, &g_state.ds_outpacket, len, 0,
1034:                 (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(struct sockaddr_in));
1035: }
1036: 
1037: /****************************************************************************
1038:  * Name: dhcpd_sendoffer
1039:  ****************************************************************************/
1040: 
1041: static inline int dhcpd_sendoffer(int sockfd, in_addr_t ipaddr,
1042:                                   uint32_t leasetime)
1043: {
1044:   in_addr_t netaddr;
1045: #ifdef HAVE_DNSIP
1046:   uint32_t dnsaddr;
1047:   dnsaddr = htonl(g_dhcpd_config.ds_dnsip);
1048: #endif
1049:   /* IP address is in host order */
1050: 
1051:   ninfo("Sending offer: %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1052: 
1053:   /* Initialize the outgoing packet */
1054: 
1055:   dhcpd_initpacket(DHCPOFFER);
1056: 
1057:   /* Add the address offered to the client (converting to network order) */
1058: 
1059:   netaddr = htonl(ipaddr);
1060:   memcpy(g_state.ds_outpacket.yiaddr, &netaddr, 4);
1061: 
1062:   /* Add the leasetime to the response options */
1063: 
1064:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_LEASE_TIME, htonl(leasetime));
1065: #ifdef HAVE_NETMASK
1066:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_SUBNET_MASK,
1067:                     htonl(g_dhcpd_config.ds_netmask));
1068: #endif
1069: #ifdef HAVE_ROUTERIP
1070:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_ROUTER,
1071:                     htonl(g_dhcpd_config.ds_routerip));
1072: #endif
1073: #ifdef HAVE_DNSIP
1074:   dhcp_addoption32p(DHCP_OPTION_DNS_SERVER, (FAR uint8_t *)&dnsaddr);
1075: #endif
1076: 
1077:   /* Send the offer response */
1078: 
1079: #ifdef CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_IGNOREBROADCAST
1080:   return dhcpd_sendpacket(sockfd, true);
1081: #else
1082:   return dhcpd_sendpacket(sockfd, false);
1083: #endif
1084: }

1086: /****************************************************************************
1087:  * Name: dhcpd_sendnak
1088:  ****************************************************************************/
1089: 
1090: static int dhcpd_sendnak(int sockfd)
1091: {
1092:   /* Initialize and send the NAK response */
1093: 
1094:   dhcpd_initpacket(DHCPNAK);
1095:   memcpy(g_state.ds_outpacket.ciaddr, g_state.ds_inpacket.ciaddr, 4);
1096:   return dhcpd_sendpacket(sockfd, true);
1097: }

1099: /****************************************************************************
1100:  * Name: dhcpd_sendack
1101:  ****************************************************************************/
1102: 
1103: int dhcpd_sendack(int sockfd, in_addr_t ipaddr)
1104: {
1105:   uint32_t leasetime = CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_LEASETIME;
1106:   in_addr_t netaddr;
1107: #ifdef HAVE_DNSIP
1108:   uint32_t dnsaddr;
1109:   dnsaddr = htonl(g_dhcpd_config.ds_dnsip);
1110: #endif
1111: 
1112:   /* Initialize the ACK response */
1113: 
1114:   dhcpd_initpacket(DHCPACK);
1115:   memcpy(g_state.ds_outpacket.ciaddr, g_state.ds_inpacket.ciaddr, 4);
1116: 
1117:   /* Add the IP address assigned to the client */
1118: 
1119:   netaddr = htonl(ipaddr);
1120:   memcpy(g_state.ds_outpacket.yiaddr, &netaddr, 4);
1121: 
1122:   /* Did the client request a specific lease time? */
1123: 
1124:   dhcpd_verifyreqleasetime(&leasetime);
1125: 
1126:   /* Add the lease time to the response */
1127: 
1128:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_LEASE_TIME, htonl(leasetime));
1129: #ifdef HAVE_NETMASK
1130:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_SUBNET_MASK,
1131:                     htonl(g_dhcpd_config.ds_netmask));
1132: #endif
1133: #ifdef HAVE_ROUTERIP
1134:   dhcpd_addoption32(DHCP_OPTION_ROUTER,
1135:                     htonl(g_dhcpd_config.ds_routerip));
1136: #endif
1137: #ifdef HAVE_DNSIP
1138:   dhcp_addoption32p(DHCP_OPTION_DNS_SERVER, (FAR uint8_t *)&dnsaddr);
1139: #endif
1140: 
1141: #ifdef CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_IGNOREBROADCAST
1142:   if (dhcpd_sendpacket(sockfd, true) < 0)
1143: #else
1144:   if (dhcpd_sendpacket(sockfd, false) < 0)
1145: #endif
1146:     {
1147:       return ERROR;
1148:     }
1149: 
1150:   dhcpd_setlease(g_state.ds_inpacket.chaddr, ipaddr, leasetime);
1151:   return OK;
1152: }

1154: /****************************************************************************
1155:  * Name: dhcpd_discover
1156:  ****************************************************************************/
1157: 
1158: static inline int dhcpd_discover(int sockfd)
1159: {
1160:   struct lease_s *lease;
1161:   in_addr_t ipaddr;
1162:   uint32_t leasetime = CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_LEASETIME;
1163: 
1164:   /* Check if the client is already in the lease table */
1165: 
1166:   lease = dhcpd_findbymac(g_state.ds_inpacket.chaddr);
1167:   if (lease)
1168:     {
1169:       /* Yes... get the remaining time on the lease */
1170: 
1171: #ifdef HAVE_LEASE_TIME
1172:       if (!dhcpd_leaseexpired(lease))
1173:         {
1174:           leasetime = lease->expiry - dhcpd_time();
1175:           if (leasetime < CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MINLEASETIME)
1176:             {
1177:               leasetime = CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MINLEASETIME;
1178:             }
1179:         }
1180: #endif
1181: 
1182:       /* Get the IP address associated with the lease (host order) */
1183: 
1184:       ipaddr = dhcp_leaseipaddr(lease);
1185:       ninfo("Already have lease for IP %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1186:     }
1187: 
1188:   /* Check if the client has requested a specific IP address */
1189: 
1190:   else if (dhcpd_verifyreqip())
1191:     {
1192:       /* Use the requested IP address (host order) */
1193: 
1194:       ipaddr = g_state.ds_optreqip;
1195:       ninfo("User requested IP %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1196:     }
1197:   else
1198:     {
1199:       /* No... allocate a new IP address (host order) */
1200: 
1201:       ipaddr = dhcpd_allocipaddr();
1202:       ninfo("Allocated IP %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1203:     }
1204: 
1205:   /* Did we get any IP address? */
1206: 
1207:   if (!ipaddr)
1208:     {
1209:       /* Nope... return failure */
1210: 
1211:       nerr("ERROR: Failed to get IP address\n");
1212:       return ERROR;
1213:     }
1214: 
1215:   /* Reserve the leased IP for a shorter time for the offer */
1216: 
1217:   if (!dhcpd_setlease(g_state.ds_inpacket.chaddr, ipaddr,
1218:                       CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_OFFERTIME))
1219:     {
1220:       nerr("ERROR: Failed to set lease\n");
1221:       return ERROR;
1222:     }
1223: 
1224:   /* Check if the client has requested a specific lease time */
1225: 
1226:   dhcpd_verifyreqleasetime(&leasetime);
1227: 
1228:   /* Send the offer response */
1229: 
1230:   return dhcpd_sendoffer(sockfd, ipaddr, leasetime);
1231: }

1233: /****************************************************************************
1234:  * Name: dhcpd_request
1235:  ****************************************************************************/
1236: 
1237: static inline int dhcpd_request(int sockfd)
1238: {
1239:   struct lease_s *lease;
1240:   in_addr_t ipaddr = 0;
1241:   uint8_t response = 0;
1242: 
1243:   /* Check if this client already holds a lease. This can happen when the
1244:    * client (1) the IP is reserved for the client from a previous offer,
1245:    * or (2) the client is re-initializing or rebooting while the lease is
1246:    * still valid.
1247:    */
1248: 
1249:   lease = dhcpd_findbymac(g_state.ds_inpacket.chaddr);
1250:   if (lease)
1251:     {
1252:       /* Yes.. the client already holds a lease.  Verify that the request is
1253:        * consistent* with the existing lease (host order).
1254:        */
1255: 
1256:       ipaddr = dhcp_leaseipaddr(lease);
1257:       ninfo("Lease ipaddr: %08" PRIx32 " Server IP: %08" PRIx32
1258:             " Requested IP: %08" PRIx32 "\n",
1259:             (uint32_t)ipaddr,
1260:             (uint32_t)g_state.ds_optserverip,
1261:             (uint32_t)g_state.ds_optreqip);
1262: 
1263:       if (g_state.ds_optserverip)
1264:         {
1265:           /* ACK if the serverip is correct and the requested IP address is
1266:            * the one already offered to the client.
1267:            */
1268: 
1269:           if (g_state.ds_optserverip == ntohl(g_state.ds_serverip) &&
1270:              (g_state.ds_optreqip != 0 || g_state.ds_optreqip == ipaddr))
1271:             {
1272:               response = DHCPACK;
1273:             }
1274:           else
1275:             {
1276:               response = DHCPNAK;
1277:             }
1278:         }
1279: 
1280:       /* We have the lease and no server IP was requested. Was a specific IP
1281:        * address requested? (host order)
1282:        */
1283: 
1284:       else if (g_state.ds_optreqip)
1285:         {
1286:           /* Yes..ACK if the requested IP address is the one already leased.
1287:            * Both addresses are in host order.
1288:            */
1289: 
1290:           if (ipaddr == g_state.ds_optreqip)
1291:             {
1292:               response = DHCPACK;
1293:             }
1294:           else
1295:             {
1296:               response = DHCPNAK;
1297:             }
1298:         }
1299: 
1300:       /* The client has specified neither a server IP nor requested
1301:        * IP address
1302:        */
1303: 
1304:       else
1305:         {
1306:           /* ACK if the IP used by the client is the one already assigned
1307:            * to it. NOTE ipaddr is in host order; ciaddr is network order!
1308:            */
1309: 
1310:           uint32_t tmp = htonl(ipaddr);
1311:           if (memcmp(&tmp, g_state.ds_inpacket.ciaddr, 4) == 0)
1312:             {
1313:               response = DHCPACK;
1314:             }
1315:           else
1316:             {
1317:               response = DHCPNAK;
1318:             }
1319:         }
1320:     }
1321: 
1322:   /* The client does not hold a lease (referenced by its MAC address) and is
1323:    * requesting a specific IP address that was, apparently, never offered to
1324:    * to the client.  Perform some sanity checks before sending the NAK.
1325:    */
1326: 
1327:   else if (g_state.ds_optreqip && !g_state.ds_optserverip)
1328:     {
1329:       ninfo("Server IP: %08" PRIx32 " Requested IP: %08" PRIx32 "\n",
1330:             (uint32_t)g_state.ds_optserverip,
1331:             (uint32_t)g_state.ds_optreqip);
1332: 
1333:       /* Is this IP address already assigned? */
1334: 
1335:       lease = dhcpd_findbyipaddr(g_state.ds_optreqip);
1336:       if (lease)
1337:         {
1338:           /* Yes.. Send NAK unless the lease has expired */
1339: 
1340:           if (!dhcpd_leaseexpired(lease))
1341:             {
1342:               response = DHCPNAK;
1343:             }
1344:         }
1345: 
1346:       /* DHCPREQUEST without DHCPDISCOVER:
1347:        * The request IP address is in the range but has not been leased,
1348:        * maybe requested before the last shutdown, lease again.
1349:        */
1350: 
1351:       else if (g_state.ds_optreqip >= g_dhcpd_config.ds_startip &&
1352:                g_state.ds_optreqip <= g_dhcpd_config.ds_endip)
1353:         {
1354:           ipaddr = g_state.ds_optreqip;
1355:           response = DHCPACK;
1356:         }
1357: 
1358:       /* The requested IP address out of range, negative */
1359: 
1360:       else
1361:         {
1362:           response = DHCPNAK;
1363:         }
1364:     }
1365: 
1366:   /* Otherwise, the client does not hold a lease and is not requesting any
1367:    * specific IP address.
1368:    */
1369: 
1370:   /* Finally, either (1) send the ACK, (2) send a NAK, or (3) remain silent
1371:    * based on the checks above.
1372:    */
1373: 
1374:   if (response == DHCPACK)
1375:     {
1376:       ninfo("ACK IP %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1377:       dhcpd_sendack(sockfd, ipaddr);
1378:     }
1379:   else if (response == DHCPNAK)
1380:     {
1381:       ninfo("NAK IP %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1382:       dhcpd_sendnak(sockfd);
1383:     }
1384:   else
1385:     {
1386:       ninfo("Remaining silent IP %08lx\n", (long)ipaddr);
1387:     }
1388: 
1389:   return OK;
1390: }

1440: {
1441:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
1442:   struct ifreq req;
1443:   int sockfd;
1444:   int ret;

1446:   /* Create a socket to listen for requests from DHCP clients */
1447: 
1448:   sockfd = dhcpd_socket(interface);

1450:     {

1462:       close(sockfd);

1466:   g_state.ds_serverip = ((FAR struct sockaddr_in *)
1467:     &req.ifr_addr)->sin_addr.s_addr;
1468: 
1469:   ninfo("serverip: %08" PRIx32 "\n", ntohl(g_state.ds_serverip));
1470: 
1471:   /* Bind the socket to a local port. We have to bind to INADDRY_ANY to
1472:    * receive broadcast messages.
1473:    */
1474: 
1475:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
1476:   addr.sin_port        = htons(DHCP_SERVER_PORT);
1477:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;

1480:   if (ret < 0)

1483:            addr.sin_port, (long)addr.sin_addr.s_addr, errno);
1484:       close(sockfd);
1485:       return ERROR;
1486:     }
1487: 
1488:   return sockfd;

# 只读调查结论

调查范围包括：

- `app/velasight/vs_network.c`
- `app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c`
- VelaSight/配网 Web 的 Kconfig 与实际生成 `.config`
- NuttX `dhcpd`、`netlib_set_ipv4addr()` / `netlib_set_ipv4netmask()`
- CP lwIP 的 SoftAP IPv4 所有权与 ARP/IPv4 转发逻辑
- BK7258 Wi-Fi AP 启动、carrier、数据收发时序
- 实际构建脚本和 CP 配置

未修改任何文件，也未执行会修改板端配置或文件的命令。

## 先给出关键事实

应用期望的 SoftAP 网络参数是：

```text
板端 IP：192.168.10.1/24
DHCP 池：192.168.10.2 ~ 192.168.10.5
DHCP Router：192.168.10.1
HTTP：0.0.0.0:80
```

证据：

- `vs_network.c:207` 设置 `0xc0a80a01`
- `vs_network.c:216` 设置 `0xffffff00`
- `ai_agent/defconfig:142-146` 设置 DHCP 起始地址、路由、掩码和租约数
- 生成的实际配置 `.config:3336` 为 `CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT=80`
- `vp_server.c:472-480` 绑定 `0.0.0.0:80` 并 `listen(fd, 2)`

`0xc0a80a01` 在当前写法中不是字节序错误：应用先执行 `htonl()`，而 `netlib_set_ipv4addr()` 直接把 `struct in_addr` 复制给 `SIOCSIFADDR`，符合网络字节序接口约定。

---

# 1) 最可能根因，按概率排序

## 根因一：SoftAP 的 ARP/IPv4 数据面跨 CP/AP 核没有真正打通，或刷入的 CP 镜像没有包含 SoftAP IPv4 ownership 配置

**综合概率：约 40%；如果手机已经拿到 `192.168.10.x`，但 ping `192.168.10.1` 失败，则该项概率升至 70% 以上。**

这是最符合“手机能关联 SoftAP，但无法访问板端 IP”的原因。

### 代码证据

CP lwIP 在启用：

```c
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4=y
```

时，会明确关闭 CP 侧 SoftAP L3 配置和 CP DHCP：

- `external/.../lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:805-812`

```c
#if CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4
  /* Keep the Wi-Fi VIF for role mapping, but leave all SoftAP L3 state on
   * OpenVela.  In particular, do not configure g_uap or start CP DHCP. */
  uap_ip_start_flag = false;
  return;
#endif
```

- `net.c:1042-1046`

```c
#if CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4
  if (if_handle == &g_uap) {
    /* Never allow a future direct caller to claim SoftAP L3 on CP. */
    return 0;
  }
#endif
```

- `net.c:1137-1144`

```c
} else if (if_handle == &g_uap) {
#if CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4
  up_iface = 0;
#else
  dhcp_server_start(net_get_uap_handle());
  ap_set_default_netif();
  up_iface = 0;
#endif
}
```

也就是说，当前架构要求：

- CP 负责 SoftAP beacon、认证、关联、EAPOL；
- NuttX/AP 核负责 SoftAP 的 IP、ARP、DHCP、TCP 和 HTTP；
- CP 必须把 SoftAP 客户端的 ARP/IPv4 帧转发到 AP 核。

CP 数据分流代码也明确依赖该开关：

- `external/.../controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:438-455`

```c
#if CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4
  const bool softap_owns_ipv4 =
      ordinary_vif && vif_type == NETIF_IF_AP;
#else
  const bool softap_owns_ipv4 = false;
#endif
```

- ARP 在 `cif_wifi_dp.c:479-489` 中，`ap_owns_ipv4` 成立时才会送到 AP 核；
- IPv4 在 `cif_wifi_dp.c:573-638` 中，同样依赖 `ap_owns_ipv4` 才 direct-push 给 AP 核。

如果刷入的 CP 固件没有使用这个配置，会出现典型症状：

1. 手机可以发现并关联 SoftAP；
2. CP 仍然拥有或吞掉 SoftAP ARP/IPv4；
3. NuttX 可以成功设置 `wlan0` 地址；
4. HTTP 服务器也可能成功打印 `listening`；
5. 但手机发出的 ARP/DHCP/TCP 报文到不了 NuttX；
6. 浏览器表现为连接超时或无法打开页面。

### 仓库配置证据

仓库中的 CP 配置 fragment 已经包含：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:419`
  - `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER=y`
- `:444`
  - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH=y`
- `:445`
  - `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4=y`
- `:446`
  - `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4=y`

但是该配置属于 CP/Armino 构建链，不是 NuttX 的 `ai_agent/defconfig`。`build_and_flash.sh:75-83` 会另外调用容器内的 `app_ab` 构建并打包 CP 镜像。因此必须确认实际刷入的 CP 镜像确实由这份配置重新生成，而不能只确认 NuttX `.config`。

项目状态文档也没有把 SoftAP 双向数据面列为完全验收项：

- `docs/SKILLS.md:125`

> SoftAP、DHCP 和 NuttX 启动已实板通过；双向数据面、反复切换和稳定性门禁待完成

这进一步支持“控制面已通，但数据面仍可能失败”。

### 最小修复建议

优先不要改 HTTP 代码，而是：

1. 用当前 `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` 重新生成 CP 配置；
2. 确认生成的 CP `sdkconfig.h` 中存在：

```text
#define CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER 1
#define CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH 1
#define CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4 1
#define CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4 1
```

3. 重新生成与当前 NuttX AP 镜像配套的 CP/APP 包并刷入；
4. 以手机获取 DHCP 地址、手机 ping `192.168.10.1`、手机访问 HTTP 作为最小验收闭环。

如果 CP 固件不能保证该 ownership 模式，则必须在架构上二选一：

- 要么 CP 完整拥有 SoftAP IP/ARP/DHCP，同时 HTTP 不能直接绑定 NuttX `wlan0`；
- 要么保持当前设计，让 CP 完整转发 SoftAP ARP/IPv4 给 NuttX。

不能让 CP 和 NuttX 同时“部分拥有”SoftAP L3。

---

## 根因二：板端显示的配网页面 IP 是硬编码占位符，用户很可能访问了错误地址

**综合概率：约 25%；如果手机实际已经拿到 DHCP 地址但用户按屏幕提示访问，则该项概率很高。**

这是当前应用中一个确定存在的缺陷。

### 代码证据

应用虽然设置了真实地址，但状态字段写入的是占位字符串：

- `vs_network.c:253-255`

```c
snprintf(network->status.address, sizeof(network->status.address),
         "***.***.**.*");
```

显示层又没有使用 `network.address`，而是直接写死：

- `app/velasight/vs_display.c:195-202`

```c
if (snapshot->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP)
  {
    ...
    vs_panel_set_text(panel, "热点密码", snapshot->network.password,
                      "网页 ***.***.**.*");
    ...
    return;
  }
```

因此，即使 `wlan0` 实际配置为 `192.168.10.1`，屏幕也不会显示真实 IP。

实际地址来源：

- `vs_network.c:207`

```c
address.s_addr = htonl(0xc0a80a01);
```

即：

```text
192.168.10.1
```

HTTP 服务监听的是所有 IPv4 地址：

- `vp_server.c:472-480`

```c
addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
addr.sin_port        = htons(port);
addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);

if (bind(fd, ...) < 0 ||
    listen(fd, 2) < 0)
```

所以在配置成功且数据面正常的情况下，正确 URL 应为：

```text
http://192.168.10.1/
```

### 最小修复建议

最小应用修复是：

1. 将 `vs_network.c:253` 改为真实地址字符串，例如 `192.168.10.1`；
2. 更好的方式是在 `vs_display.c` 使用 `snapshot->network.address`；
3. 不要在 UI 中继续写死占位符。

建议最终显示：

```text
网页 192.168.10.1
```

如果未来 IP 可配置，则应通过 `inet_ntop()` 或等价逻辑从 `struct in_addr` 生成字符串，而不是重复维护常量。

### 重要判断

- 如果用户访问的是 `192.168.10.1`，且手机已获得 `192.168.10.2` 等地址，则该根因可以排除；
- 如果用户是按照板端屏幕上的 `网页 ***.***.**.*` 操作，则这是直接的应用层故障。

---

## 根因三：`dhcpd_start()` 只是创建后台任务，应用没有确认 DHCP 监听 socket 是否真正建立

**综合概率：约 18%；更容易表现为手机关联成功但没有拿到有效 IP。**

### 代码证据：应用启动顺序

`vs_network_apply_ap()` 的顺序是：

- `vs_network.c:176-182`：ifdown/ifup
- `vs_network.c:184-200`：配置 SoftAP 参数并发起 AP
- `vs_network.c:207-220`：设置 `wlan0` IPv4 和掩码
- `vs_network.c:223-230`：启动 DHCP
- `vs_network.c:235-242`：启动 HTTP
- `vs_network.c:244-255`：最后标记 `VS_NET_AP_READY`

```c
ret = dhcpd_start("wlan0");
...
network->dhcp_running = true;
...
ret = velasight_provisioning_start(&provision);
...
network->provision_running = true;
...
network->status.state = VS_NET_AP_READY;
```

表面顺序是正确的：先地址，再 DHCP，再 HTTP。

但 NuttX DHCPD 的 `dhcpd_start()` 本身是异步的：

- `apps/netutils/dhcpd/dhcpd.c:1721-1751`

```c
pid = task_create("dhcpd", ... dhcpd_task_run, argv);
...
return OK;
```

真正的 DHCP socket 创建、读取接口地址、绑定 UDP/67，发生在后台任务中：

- `dhcpd.c:1574-1616`：DHCPD task 初始化；
- `dhcpd.c:1620-1632`：后台循环中调用 `dhcpd_openlistener()`；
- `dhcpd.c:1439-1488`：读取 `SIOCGIFADDR`、绑定 UDP/67。

如果后台任务稍后失败，例如：

```text
SIOCGIFADDR 失败
bind UDP/67 失败
接口状态尚未稳定
端口被旧 DHCPD 占用
```

`dhcpd_start()` 之前已经返回 `0`，应用仍然会继续启动 HTTP，并把网络状态标记为 Ready。应用没有等待或复核 DHCPD 是否已成功进入监听状态。

另外，`vs_network.c:40-45` 的 `dhcpd_stop()` 只在应用自己认为 `dhcp_running` 时调用；如果 DHCPD 子任务启动后立即失败，应用仍可能把 `dhcp_running` 保持为 `true`，状态与实际进程不一致。

### 地址配置本身没有明显错误

`netlib_set_ipv4addr()`：

- `apps/netutils/netlib/netlib_setipv4addr.c:59-88`

直接把传入的 `struct in_addr` 送给 `SIOCSIFADDR`。

`netlib_set_ipv4netmask()`：

- `apps/netutils/netlib/netlib_setipv4netmask.c:58-87`

同样直接送给 `SIOCSIFNETMASK`。

而应用使用：

- `vs_network.c:207`
  - `htonl(0xc0a80a01)`
- `vs_network.c:208`
  - `htonl(0xffffff00)`

这是正确的网络序用法，不能把它作为首要根因。

### 最小修复建议

应用层最小修复方向：

1. 在启动 HTTP 前确认 `wlan0` 已处于 `RUNNING`，并且 `SIOCGIFADDR` 返回 `192.168.10.1`；
2. 对 AP carrier/接口状态进行有限重试，而不是只依赖 `wapi` 调用返回；
3. 最好扩展 DHCPD 启动接口，使其能报告后台 `bind()`/`SIOCGIFADDR` 失败；
4. 在 DHCPD 未成功建立监听前，不要把 UI 状态标记为 `VS_NET_AP_READY`。

当前 Wi-Fi 驱动的 AP 启动接口实际上会查询 AP 状态：

- `bk7258_wifi.c:2133-2157`

包括：

```c
wifi_ap_status_query(&ap_status);
...
if (!ap_status.started)
  ret = -EIO;
...
wifi_ap_start_event(true);
```

因此 AP beacon 启动本身不像是纯异步“立即返回”；更主要的异步盲区是 DHCPD 后台任务。

## 根因四：实际刷入镜像中没有包含配网 Web，或 HTTP 线程已经因异常退出

**综合概率：约 8%～10%；如果串口没有看到 `provision_web: listening`，该项概率应升高。**

### 配置证据

产品 `ai_agent/defconfig` 已启用：

- `:115`
  - `CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_PROVISION_WEB=y`
- `:116`
  - `CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_VELASIGHT=y`
- `:129`
  - `CONFIG_NET=y`
- `:141`
  - `CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD=y`
- `:159-162`
  - TCP、`CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG`、UDP 已启用

实际生成的 `.config` 还确认：

- `.config:1091`
  - `CONFIG_NET_BINDTODEVICE=y`
- `.config:1153-1154`
  - `CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG=y`
  - `CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG_CONNS=8`
- `.config:3334-3336`
  - 配网 Web、存储路径、80 端口均存在

Kconfig 也明确要求 TCP backlog：

- `app/provisioning_web/Kconfig:6-24`

特别是：

```text
NET_TCPBACKLOG is required ...
Without it ... POLLIN on a listening socket is unreachable
```

因此当前产品构建配置已经满足 HTTP poll 的必要条件。

### HTTP 生命周期证据

- `vp_server.c:462-480`
  - 创建 socket、`SO_REUSEADDR`、绑定 `0.0.0.0:80`、listen
- `vp_server.c:486-508`
  - 设置全局 listener，创建 pthread
- `vp_server.c:511-513`
  - 打印 listening
- `vp_server.c:320-351`
  - 监听 socket 上 `poll(..., POLLIN, 200ms)` 后 accept
- `vp_server.c:364-370`
  - 请求处理完后关闭连接
- `vp_server.c:401-410`
  - 线程退出时关闭 listenfd，设置 `VP_STATE_FINISHED`

正常条件下，HTTP server 的 bind/listen/poll 逻辑没有明显必然失败点。

### 一个较小的健壮性问题

`vp_thread()` 在 `poll()` 返回非零时没有检查 `pfd.revents`：

- `vp_server.c:335-351`

它直接调用：

```c
fd = accept(g_server.listenfd, NULL, NULL);
```

如果收到的是 `POLLERR`、`POLLHUP` 而不是 `POLLIN`，`accept()` 失败后线程会退出：

- `vp_server.c:351-360`

这不是正常首个连接失败的主要解释，但如果监听 socket 或 TCP backlog 异常，可能导致“曾经打印 listening，之后不再响应”。

### 最小修复建议

1. 确认实际启动日志中存在：

```text
provision_web: listening on 0.0.0.0:80
```

2. 在 `poll()` 后只对 `POLLIN` 调用 `accept()`；
3. 对 `POLLERR/POLLHUP/POLLNVAL` 打印具体错误；
4. 在应用状态中暴露 `velasight_provisioning_is_running()`，不要仅凭 `velasight_provisioning_start()` 返回值判断服务仍在运行。

不过，当前实际 `ai_agent` 构建的 `System.map` 已包含：

```text
velasight_provisioning_start
vp_thread
vs_network_request_mode
dhcpd_start
dhcpd_run
netlib_set_ipv4addr
netlib_set_ipv4netmask
```

所以“代码没有被链接进产品”的概率不高。

## 根因五：HTTP bind/listen/poll 或 IP 字节序错误

**概率：低于 5%。目前源码证据不支持把它列为首要根因。**

### HTTP bind/listen

- `vp_server.c:472-480`

```c
addr.sin_port        = htons(port);
addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);

if (bind(...) < 0 ||
    listen(fd, 2) < 0)
```

端口是 `CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT=80`，绑定地址是 `0.0.0.0`，不是只绑定回环地址，也不是绑定到错误接口。

### poll 条件

- `vp_server.c:328-332`
- `app/provisioning_web/Kconfig:18-24`

代码和 Kconfig 都明确要求 `CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG`，实际产品配置也已启用。因此此前常见的“listen 成功但 poll 永远没有事件”的配置错误，在当前 `ai_agent` 实际 `.config` 中没有出现。

### 字节序

应用：

```c
address.s_addr = htonl(0xc0a80a01);
netmask.s_addr = htonl(0xffffff00);
```

netlib：

```c
memcpy(&inaddr->sin_addr, addr, sizeof(struct in_addr));
```

DHCPD 配置值：

```text
CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_STARTIP=0xc0a80a02
CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_ROUTERIP=0xc0a80a01
CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_NETMASK=0xffffff00
```

DHCPD 内部把配置值当 host order 保存，在发送 option 时再 `htonl()`：

- `dhcpd.c:1041-1072`
- `dhcpd.c:1103-1136`

因此应用地址与 DHCP 地址配置是一致的：

```text
server：192.168.10.1
lease：192.168.10.2 ...
mask：255.255.255.0
```

不建议仅凭 `0xc0a80a01` 的表面形式去删除 `htonl()`；那反而可能引入真正的字节序错误。

# 2) 各根因对应的证据摘要

| 优先级 | 根因 | 关键证据 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | CP/AP SoftAP ARP/IPv4 数据面未打通，或 CP 镜像配置不匹配 | CP `net.c:805-812` 禁用 CP SoftAP L3；`cif_wifi_dp.c:450-455` 依赖 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4`；ARP/IPv4 direct-push 在 `:479-489`、`:573-638` |
| 2 | UI 显示/引导的 IP 是占位符 | `vs_network.c:253-255`；`vs_display.c:195-202` |
| 3 | DHCPD 后台启动成功不等于 UDP/67 已绑定 | `vs_network.c:223-230`；`dhcpd.c:1721-1751` 异步 `task_create()`；真正 bind 在 `dhcpd.c:1439-1488`、`:1620-1632` |
| 4 | Web 未启动或 listener 线程退出 | `vp_server.c:462-513`；poll/accept 逻辑 `:320-360`；实际配置 `ai_agent/.config:3334-3336` |
| 5 | HTTP backlog 或 IP 字节序 | 实际 `.config:1091`、`:1153-1154`；netlib `netlib_setipv4addr.c:59-88`；当前证据不支持其为主因 |

# 3) 建议的最小修复顺序

## 第一优先：先验证而不是修改 NuttX HTTP

在实际刷入的固件上确认以下三件事：

1. `wlan0` 是否真实为：

```text
RUNNING
192.168.10.1
255.255.255.0
```

2. 手机是否拿到：

```text
192.168.10.2 ~ 192.168.10.5
网关 192.168.10.1
掩码 /24
```

3. 手机是否能 ping：

```text
192.168.10.1
```

判断方式：

- 手机没有 DHCP 地址：优先查 CP/AP 数据面或 DHCPD 启动时序；
- 手机有 `192.168.10.x`，但 ping `192.168.10.1` 失败：优先查 CP/AP ARP/IPv4 direct-push；
- 手机能 ping `192.168.10.1`，但 TCP/80 不通：再查 HTTP listener；
- 手机能连 TCP/80，但浏览器页面异常：才进入 HTTP parser/请求处理层。

## 第二优先：重新验证配套 CP 镜像

确保 CP 构建和刷入过程使用了：

```text
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER=y
CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH=y
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4=y
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4=y
```

并且 CP 镜像与当前 NuttX AP 镜像来自同一次打包流程。

## 第三优先：修复 UI 地址显示

将 UI 中的：

```text
网页 ***.***.**.*
```

改为使用 `network.address`，并使 `network.address` 保存真实的：

```text
192.168.10.1
```

这属于确定的应用层修复，成本最低。

## 第四优先：补充 DHCPD/AP ready 复核

当前代码把：

```text
dhcpd_start() 返回 0
```

等同于：

```text
DHCP 已监听 UDP/67
```

这是不成立的。建议后续增加：

- AP carrier/RUNNING 等待；
- IPv4 地址读取复核；
- DHCPD bind 失败可观测机制；
- 只有 DHCP 和 HTTP 都仍然运行时才显示 `VS_NET_AP_READY`。

# 4) 可用于确认的安全串口命令

以下命令均为诊断用途，不建议使用 `ps`，也不会修改配网文件或 Wi-Fi 凭据。

## A. 查看接口地址和链路状态

进入 SoftAP 后执行：

```sh
ifconfig wlan0
```

应重点确认：

```text
RUNNING
inet addr:192.168.10.1
Mask:255.255.255.0
```

注意：

- 只有 `UP`、没有 `RUNNING`，说明管理状态已打开，但 AP carrier/beacon 数据面尚未正常；
- 没有 `inet addr` 或地址不是 `192.168.10.1`，说明应用设置地址失败、被后续逻辑覆盖，或者实际运行的不是当前镜像。

## B. 查看 Wi-Fi AP 控制面状态

```sh
wapi show wlan0
```

重点确认：

```text
WAPI_MODE_MASTER
目标 ESSID
channel 6
AP MAC
```

这只能证明 SoftAP 控制面/配置状态，不能单独证明 ARP/IPv4 数据面已经打通。

## C. 查看 Web server 是否成功监听

```sh
cat /proc/net/tcp
```

如果 `/proc/net/tcp` 可用，查找本地端口：

```text
0050
```

`80` 的十六进制是 `0050`。

同时观察串口日志中是否出现：

```text
provision_web: listening on 0.0.0.0:80
```

以及：

```text
velasight: SoftAP ready, ssid=... channel=...
```

如果有 `SoftAP ready`，但没有 `provision_web: listening`，说明 HTTP 启动失败或实际执行路径不是当前代码。

## D. 查看 UDP 状态

```sh
cat /proc/net/udp
```

不同 NuttX 版本输出格式可能不同，但可以辅助观察 UDP/67 是否存在。

也可以先列出 procfs 网络节点：

```sh
ls /proc/net
```

这是只读命令。如果某个节点不存在，不代表网络一定异常，只代表该 NuttX 版本没有导出对应统计项。

## E. 查看路由

```sh
cat /proc/net/route
```

SoftAP 本地访问并不要求公网默认路由，但可以确认是否出现异常的路由残留。

## F. 从板端 ping 手机

先在手机 Wi-Fi 详情中确认手机地址。若手机拿到的是 `192.168.10.2`，可执行：

```sh
ping -I wlan0 -c 3 -W 1000 192.168.10.2
```

如果手机实际拿到的是其他地址，把命令中的地址替换为手机真实地址。

这个测试可以确认：

- DHCP 地址是否可达；
- NuttX 发往 SoftAP 客户端的 TX 路径是否正常；
- CP/AP 的双向数据面是否基本工作。

## G. 从板端 ping 自身地址

```sh
ping -I wlan0 -c 3 -W 1000 192.168.10.1
```

这只能验证本地 NuttX IP/ICMP 基本功能，**不能证明手机到板端的 ARP 和跨核数据面正常**。因此它成功而手机仍无法访问，并不能排除根因一。

## H. 确认内置命令是否存在

```sh
help
```

检查输出中是否包含：

```text
ifconfig
wapi
ping
provision_web
dhcpd_start
dhcpd_stop
```

当前产品的实际构建配置已经包含：

- `CONFIG_NSH_BUILTIN_APPS=y`
- `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DHCPD=y`
- `CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_PROVISION_WEB=y`

因此如果串口 `help` 缺少这些命令，应怀疑实际刷入的不是当前 `ai_agent` 镜像。

## I. 只读检查配网存储状态

```sh
provision_web show
```

该命令按源码设计只显示 SSID、安全类型、密码是否存在和 generation，不打印密码。它主要用于确认配网存储，不用于确认网络数据面。

不要使用：

```sh
provision_web selftest
```

因为源码注释明确说明它会覆盖存储记录：

- `provisioning_web_main.c:162-170`

---

## 最终判断

如果现场现象是：

```text
手机可以关联 SoftAP
手机有 192.168.10.x 地址
网关是 192.168.10.1
手机 ping 192.168.10.1 失败
```

最可能不是 HTTP `bind/listen/poll`，而是 **CP 与 NuttX 之间的 SoftAP ARP/IPv4 数据面或实际 CP 镜像配置问题**。

如果现场现象是：

```text
手机可以关联 SoftAP
手机没有拿到地址
```

优先检查 **DHCPD 后台 bind 时序、UDP/67、CP 是否把 DHCP Discover 转给 NuttX**。

如果现场现象是：

```text
手机已经能 ping 192.168.10.1
但屏幕提示的地址打不开
```

则优先修复确定存在的 **UI 硬编码占位 IP**。

如果：

```text
串口没有 provision_web listening 日志
```

才把 HTTP 服务未启动或 listener 线程退出提升为首要原因。
